Package com.solace.connectors.tracing.internal.source

Class SolaceQueueListener

java.lang.Object
org.mule.runtime.extension.api.runtime.source.Source<String,SolaceMessageAttributes>
com.solace.connectors.tracing.internal.source.SolaceQueueListener
@Alias("listener") @DisplayName("On New Message") @MediaType(value="*/*", strict=false) public class SolaceQueueListener extends org.mule.runtime.extension.api.runtime.source.Source<String,SolaceMessageAttributes>
Push-based queue listener. For each message it: 1. reads the trace context the broker wrote onto the message (SolaceJmsW3CTextMapGetter), falling back to the traceparent user property; 2. starts a CONSUMER span under it and runs the flow; 3. acknowledges the message if the flow succeeds, or calls recover() so the broker redelivers it. Each consumer has its own connection and session. The Solace dispatcher thread waits for the flow to finish before acking, so ack/recover always run on the thread that owns the JMS session, and each consumer has at most one message in flight. Use numberOfConsumers for concurrency (needs a non-exclusive queue).
